_about: Every number printed in README.md comes from this file through scripts/gen_numbers.py. Edit the values here, never in the prose, and run the script. Values are copied, with their date, from the Alchemia registry readings; this file measures nothing by itself.

registry.source: ALCHEMIA registry, release 1.9.0, local database, read by query on that date; the database behind the platform was not read again
